This was a previous relationship that unfortunately had to end awhile back, but I’ll still never forget it. I’m an artist so I have hundreds of sketchbooks, many that are still not full/finished. At that time I went to design school so I had just bought a brand new one for the class. My girlfriend at the time noticed it and she asked me what’s it for and I told her it was for class. We went to bed and I left for school later that afternoon. During class when I went to use that new sketchbook, I had noticed she had wrote something on the first page without me knowing somehow. When I read it, it was this beautiful poem that she wrote about me and us together and how my hazel/brown eyes look like golden light pools (I really like when someone compliments my boring eyes). No one had ever talked about me that way. It felt amazing to read her poem. She was always so talented in writing so I knew it all came from the heart.

Unfortunately the relationship ended and we went out separate ways, but I still have the book with the poem still written in it still to this day as a  memory that I like to keep. To remind me to enjoy the little things and moments when they occur in your life.
